newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - mostly steady.

text.p: NWE oil products ended mixed on Friday, traders said.
Naphtha swaps rose $2.50 while cargo prices were unchanged. Traders cited higher crude futures and light end-user demand.
Gasoline was steady on more buying interest for prompt supplies of refinery material, despite a shut arb to the States.
Gas oil was little changed with moderate futures gains cancelled out by softening premiums. Heating oil barges were assessed around July IPE -25 cents/+25 cents.
High sulphur fuel oil barges ended firmer with late talk at $86/$87 a tonne fob Rotterdam after trading at $87 earlier.
Demand was a little firmer at about 15,000 to 20,000 tonnes.
High sulphur cargoes seemed weaker with little buying interest for two cargoes of bunker grade material offered at $79 and $81 fob.
